title: Concatenating safe computation intervals
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, $S$ a state set, $w$ a Boolean input word, $M$ a $k$-work-tape machine over Booleans, $a\in S$ an anchor state, and $c$ a configuration of $M$ on input $w$. If the run from $c$ avoids state $a$ at every time $j\le u$, and the run of length $v$ starting from the configuration reached after $u$ steps from $c$ also avoids state $a$ at every time $j\le v$, then the run from $c$ avoids state $a$ at every time $j\le u+v$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $w$
the run from $c$ avoids $a$ through time $u$
the run from the configuration after $u$ steps avoids $a$ through time $v$
